positions.commentary: Founders Fund decided to put $150 million into Airbnb in less than a week because it represented the clearest moat they had ever seen.

thesis: This episode argues that Founders Fund identifies investment opportunities based on the presence of a durable moat, such as a massive international network effect, which protects the business from being cloned by competitors. The fund is willing to commit significant capital quickly when such a clear structural advantage is observed.
